title: Limit a route input
summary: Laravel: Limit a route input. Visit /double/cat.
introduction: whereNumber only matches numeric path text. Open GET /double/4.
learningObjectives: Limit a route input with Laravel

blocks.text: Create a practice Laravel project with Composer, then replace routes/web.php with one example. Start php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000. These read-only starter routes need no database.

blocks.title: Limit a route input
blocks.code:
<?php
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
Route::get("/double/{n}", fn (string $n) => response()->json(["answer" => (int) $n * 2]))->whereNumber("n");

blocks.text: whereNumber accepts the digits 4. Casting makes an integer before multiplication.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A route rule checks matching; it does not set every business limit.
